description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。
description.en: The page number of the current page to display in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging.

description.zh: 以任务完成时间为准的查询结束时间，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the query based on the task completion time. Unit: milliseconds.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 以任务创建时间为准的查询开始时间，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the query based on the task creation time. Unit: milliseconds.
The list of task status codes.

description.zh:
任务类型，取值：
- CHECK_ALL：全量检查。
- CHECK_POLICY：按照配置策略的检查项执行的检查。
- CHECK_SCHEDULE：定时检查。
- CHECK_ITEM：按照指定检查项检查。
- CHECK_INSTANCE：按照指定检查项加实例的检查。
description.en:
The task type. Valid values:
- CHECK_ALL: full check.
- CHECK_POLICY: check performed based on check items in the configured policy.
- CHECK_SCHEDULE: scheduled check.
- CHECK_ITEM: check performed based on specified check items.
- CHECK_INSTANCE: check performed based on specified check items and instances.

descriptions.zh: 当前仅支持检查操作任务查询。
descriptions.en: Currently, only check operation task queries are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-operation-process --task-types CHECK_POLICY --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --status-codes 0 --start-time 1680919232000 --end-time 1635575219000 --task-ids 3d7a1b68-599f-4e16-9b45-e920a183b000 --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
